game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Smoke Ridge Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ember mage ahead. Then check the predictions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the magma valve by solving code steps involving predictions that move the ember mage forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the magma valve first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
